# Vincent C. Giampapa, MD, FACS

> Board-certified plastic and reconstructive surgeon, physician-scientist and inventor working on cellular aging. Co-founder of the American Academy of Anti-Aging Medicine, first President of the American Board of Anti-Aging Medicine, nominated for a Nobel Prize in 2014 for research into cellular restoration technology conducted with the research team at Rutgers University.

Aging is not a countdown. It's a code.

## Key facts

- 24+ United States patents across stem-cell delivery, cellular reprogramming, drug delivery and surgical instrument design.
- Built the BioMarker Matrix Profile, the first computer program to measure biological age.
- Author of eight books, including *Escape Velocity from Human Aging: Breaking the Biological Speed Limit* (with Victor Urzola, MD and Liz Parrish, MBA) and *The Basic Principles and Practice of Anti-Aging Medicine & Age Management* (River Publishing, 2012), the first medical textbook on anti-aging medicine.
- More than 20 chapters contributed to medical textbooks.
- Visiting Scholar, Sinclair Lab, Paul F. Glenn Center for the Biology of Aging Research, Harvard Medical School.
- Co-founder and Chief Science Officer, Regenerative Medicine Institute (RMI), licensed in Costa Rica.
- Consulted for NASA on the space shuttle robotic arm, drawing on his sensate prosthesis patents.
- Edison Award (Healthycell); A4M Science & Technology Award (BioMarker Matrix Profile).
- MD, Mount Sinai School of Medicine. Plastic surgery training at St. Luke's and Columbia Presbyterian. Microsurgery fellowship, NYU Medical Center. Fellow of the American College of Surgeons.

## Speaking

Available for keynotes. Topics: The Future of Regenerative Medicine; Epigenetic Reprogramming and the Reversal of Biological Age; Stem Cell Technologies of the Future; Measuring What Matters: Biological Age and the BioMarker Matrix Profile.

Previous stages include the Second International Vatican Adult Stem Cell Conference, Beijing University, the Swedish American Life Science Summit in Stockholm, Abundance360, R360, Gobundance, YPO, YPO Gold, and Aster Medicine in Dubai.

Enquiries: vcg@cellhealth.net
